mapper.sql: id, room_number, rent, apartment_id, is_release, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT name, url FROM graph_info WHERE is_deleted = 0 and item_type = 2 and item_id = #{id}
SELECT id, type, name FROM label_info WHERE is_deleted = 0 and id in (SELECT label_id FROM room_label WHERE is_deleted = 0 and room_id = #{id})
SELECT min(rent) FROM room_info WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND is_release = 1 AND apartment_id = #{apartmentId,jdbcType=BIGINT} GROUP BY apartment_id

SELECT ri.id, ri.room_number, ri.rent, ai.id apartment_id, ai.name, ai.introduction, ai.district_id, ai.district_name, ai.city_id, ai.city_name, ai.province_id, ai.province_name, ai.address_detail, ai.latitude, ai.longitude, ai.phone, ai.is_release FROM room_info ri JOIN apartment_info ai ON ri.apartment_id = ai.id WHERE ri.is_deleted = 0 and ri.is_release = 1 and ai.is_deleted = 0 and ai.is_release = 1 and ri.id not in (SELECT room_id FROM lease_agreement WHERE is_deleted = 0 and status in (1, 2, 5, 7)) and ai.id = #{apartmentId}
